class.name: EditorExportPlatformWeChat
class.description: Exports a Godot project as a directory that opens in WeChat Developer Tools. The generated project loads a single-threaded, non-SIMD WebAssembly runtime and starts the Compatibility renderer on a WebGL 2 canvas for both 2D and basic 3D. A project that does not resolve to the Compatibility renderer is rejected before export. At startup the project checks that WebGL 2 can compile a Compatibility shader and provide a depth buffer. Missing stencil, float color buffers, instancing, or MSAA are reported and skipped instead of crashing. Shader compilation failures are shown with the driver log. Frame rate and memory are logged as device baselines and are not a guaranteed minimum. An empty AppID is written as the WeChat local-preview AppID so the project can be opened before a production AppID exists. Developers assign project resources to package groups explicitly. Each group is exported as a WeChat subpackage and a Godot resource pack. The game calls [method WeChat.load_resource_subpackage] and can use [code]res://[/code] files from that pack only after the subpackage loads successfully. Export rejects a main package above 4 MB and a project above the selected total budget, 20 MB by default or 30 MB for an eligible project. Godot HTTPRequest and WebSocketPeer calls use wx.request and wx.connectSocket. Enter the domains those calls need in the export preset. Export writes them to godot.wechat.json and reminds you to add them to the WeChat console allowlists. The exporter cannot configure or verify those allowlists.

members.member: ZIP export template used for debug builds. If empty, the editor looks for the official [code]wechat_debug.zip[/code] template.
ZIP export template used for release builds. If empty, the editor looks for the official [code]wechat_release.zip[/code] template.
Optional WeChat AppID. Leave empty to generate a local-preview project.

Total package budget checked during export. [code]0[/code] is the default 20 MB budget. [code]1[/code] selects the 30 MB budget for a project that is eligible for that WeChat limit. The exporter cannot verify eligibility.

Explicit resource package groups, one per line: [code]group_name:res://pattern[,res://pattern][/code]. Patterns use Godot's case-insensitive wildcards. Unmatched resources stay in the main package. Lines starting with [code]#[/code] are comments. Group names use letters, digits, [code]_[/code], or [code]-[/code], and cannot be [code]godot-runtime[/code].

HTTPS origins the game requests, one per line or comma-separated. Each entry is [code]https://host[/code] or [code]https://host:port[/code] with no path. Omit the default port 443.
